header.name: Creeper Drop All
header.description: Explosions drop 100% of the blocks they destroy, instead of the fraction vanilla leaves you.

settings.text: §l§aCreeper Drop All§r - explosions drop §l100%§r of the blocks they destroy.
§7Changes here take effect the next time the world loads.§r

§7TNT is off because Bedrock already drops every block a TNT blast destroys - the §otntExplosionDropDecay§r§7 game rule defaults to false. Mob explosions are the ones that lose blocks, and Bedrock has no game rule for those.§r

§7On: exploded leaves drop the leaf block itself, so you can put the canopy back the way it was. Off: leaves roll for saplings, sticks and apples at the ordinary vanilla rates, which means most of them drop nothing at all.§r

§7Chests, barrels, shulker boxes, furnaces, hoppers, droppers, dispensers, brewing stands and ender chests survive the blast untouched, contents and all. The crater still forms around them. Off by default, because blast-proofing storage is a bigger change than handing your blocks back.§r
§7Groups nearby drops into fewer item entities. §o1§r§7 spawns a pile at every single block - most faithful, hardest on the game. Raise it if a big blast makes things stutter.§r
§7A safety limit. An explosion bigger than this is handed back to Minecraft untouched rather than half-processed, so the worst case is ordinary vanilla behaviour.§r
